about:
OceanHead Solar & Electric operates from Honolulu on the island of Oahu, Hawaii. The company is a licensed Hawaii solar and electrical contractor (LIC# C-33164) founded by Gail and Chelli, who are described as the owners and power couple behind the business. It is certified as a Women-Owned Small Business (WOSB) and a Disadvantaged Business Enterprise (DBE), and holds an A+ rating from the Better Business Bureau.

The firm designs and installs solar photovoltaic systems, battery backup, and electric vehicle charging infrastructure for residential and commercial clients. Its in-house licensed team manages projects from initial design through permitting and final installation, handling work that ranges from single-home rooftops to multi-building government contracts. The company also repairs orphaned systems left by other installers and performs electrical infrastructure upgrades, including multi-meter buildings and higher-voltage requirements.

OceanHead serves homeowners, commercial property owners, general contractors, manufacturers, and government agencies across Oahu. Commercial projects include flat-roof and carport-mounted solar arrays, fleet EV charging deployments, and full electrical system rebuilds. The company acts as a WOSB/DBE subcontractor on large-scale government solar and electrical work, and partners with contractors needing technical depth for complex installations.

The company emphasizes its local expertise with Hawaii's salt-air and high-UV conditions, designing each system around the specific roof type and structural capacity. It offers an Energy Service Agreement that covers the upfront cost of all services, and manages Hawaiian Electric net-energy-metering applications as part of every commercial installation. The founders state their mission is to make solar and battery storage attainable and long-lasting with no barriers to commitment.
